SECTION: RCD01 §10-§11 — design of the one future minimal-reproduction test

PHASES.PHASE_1: run the exact frozen B1 law until the daughter reaches the frozen functional maturation event
PHASES.PHASE_2: at that frozen event step, apply the predeclared SELECTIVE parent-off intervention
PHASES.PHASE_3: test whether the daughter alone re-establishes and holds the qualified local X response for a physically derived hold interval

HOLD_INTERVAL_FOR_PHASE_3.derivation: the same T_PRIMARY_STEPS, one e-folding of the slowest mode of the X operator; using a shorter interval would let a decaying cloud pass

ATTACKS.response: the intervention must be qualified first: bit-identical trajectories when not armed, occupancy conserved, no X touched, no resource touched, the untouched centre's cells provably unaffected. That qualification is the successor mission, not this test.
a SHAM arm with identical scheduling and no removal, plus a GLOBAL organiser-off arm, separate daughter autonomy from the act of intervening and from generic resilience to any Y removal.

ATTACKS.attack: selection bias from conditioning on a successful Phase 1
ATTACKS.response: the PRIMARY estimand is the population rate per independently seeded world, denominator = all seeded worlds. The conditional daughter-survival probability is reported as secondary and explicitly labelled conditional.
every seeded world counts, including those that never reach Phase 2; those are reproduction failures, not exclusions.

identical horizon and identical stop rules for all arms, as in FDFLT01, except that the PREMATURE_THIRD_CENTRE stop must be reconsidered because it censors R3 by construction; changing it changes the estimand and must be declared, not slipped in.
in the denominator, as failures. A world that never forms a materially reconstructed daughter has not reproduced.
yes, two: SHAM and PRE_MATURATION_INTERVENTION. The latter tests that the maturation interval is doing work rather than the daughter being robust from birth.
yes. Without it, any difference could be the scheduling machinery rather than the removal.

PRIMARY_ESTIMAND: P(complete reproduction event per independently seeded world) = P(R0 and R1 and R2)
SECONDARY_ESTIMAND: P(daughter survives parent-off | functional materially-reconstructed daughter formed)

CONTROLS.SHAM: identical scheduling and bookkeeping, no Y removed — separates the intervention from its timing
CONTROLS.PARENT_STAYS_ON: the untouched trajectory — the FDFLT01 condition itself, already available
CONTROLS.GLOBAL_ORGANISER_OFF: the existing OBTC02 intervention — distinguishes daughter autonomy from any-Y-removal
CONTROLS.PRE_MATURATION_INTERVENTION: parent removed BEFORE the daughter matures — tests that the hold interval is doing work
CONTROLS.why_not_more: a daughter-off symmetry control adds no discrimination once the parent/daughter label is tie-broken deterministically, and multiplying arms costs the budget it would need

DECISION_CAPABILITY.note: the null must be frozen before the first world, with its derivation, exactly as FDFLT01 froze 0.10
